title: Le Conquet Wellington Memorial
crew_summary: 5 crew — all killed (one with no known grave)
memorial_details: Coastal memorial stone and plaque near Le Conquet, Finistère.
narrative: Wellington HF601 of 466 (RAAF) Squadron, coded HD-?, departed Leconfield at 2211 on 5 July 1943 on a gardening (minelaying) operation. The aircraft is believed to have been hit by Flak and shot down at approximately 0130 on 6 July, crashing into the sea near the target. All five crew were killed; one has no known grave and is commemorated on the Runnymede Memorial.
cause_of_loss: Believed hit by Flak; crashed into the sea

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 4
